Report a work's other copies as possible `reference-other` entries

Source: R/utils_preprocess_register.R
suggest_reference_other.Rd

The render's side of rule `CC-MET-010`, which reports the same in [validate_codecheck_yml_rules()]. Nothing is written: the message names the certificate and gives the YAML to add to its `codecheck.yml`.

Usage

suggest_reference_other(
  cert_id,
  record_dois,
  paper_reference,
  reference_other = character(0)
)

Arguments

cert_id

The certificate identifier

record_dois

The DOIs the record lists, see [openalex_record_dois()]

paper_reference

The paper reference

reference_other

The `reference-other` URLs, possibly empty

Value

The candidate DOIs, invisibly
